==Gu'Tanoth Island==
[[File:GuTanoth Island hard clue route.png|thumb|left|Travel route to Gu'Tanoth Island. Run from fairy ring AKS to the cave south west of Gu'Tanoth. This brings you directly to the island.]]
The ''only'' way to get onto the island is by taking a specific cave entrance, as the broken bridge leading to a small island is ''not'' passable. The correct cave entrance is found south-west of [[Gu'Tanoth]] with four rocks to its west and ruins to its south-east. Note that you do ''not'' need a [[skavid map]] to enter this cave.
